fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/institutionID
fields.title: Institution ID
fields.description: An identifier for the institution having custody of the object(s) or information referred to in the record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/datasetID
fields.title: Dataset ID
fields.description: An identifier for the set of data. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to a collection or institution.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/institutionCode
fields.title: Institution Code
fields.description: The name (or acronym) in use by the institution having custody of the object(s) or information referred to in the record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/datasetName
fields.title: Dataset Name
fields.description: The name identifying the data set from which the record was derived.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/ownerInstitutionCode
fields.title: Owner Institution Code
fields.description: The name (or acronym) in use by the institution having ownership of the object(s) or information referred to in the record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/informationWithheld
fields.title: Information Withheld
fields.description: Additional information that exists, but that has not been shared in the given record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/dataGeneralizations
fields.title: Data Generalizations
fields.description: Actions taken to make the shared data less specific or complete than in its original form. Suggests that alternative data of higher quality may be available on request.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/dynamicProperties
fields.title: Dynamic Properties
fields.description: A list of additional measurements, facts, characteristics, or assertions about the record. Meant to provide a mechanism for structured content.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/eventID
fields.title: Event ID
fields.description: An identifier for the set of information associated with a dwc:Event (something that occurs at a place and time). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/parentEventID
fields.title: Parent Event ID
fields.description: An identifier for the broader dwc:Event that groups this and potentially other dwc:Events.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/eventType
fields.title: Event Type
fields.description: The nature of the dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/fieldNumber
fields.title: Field Number
fields.description: An identifier given to the dwc:Event in the field. Often serves as a link between field notes and the dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/eventDate
fields.title: Event Date
fields.description: The date-time or interval during which a dwc:Event occurred. For occurrences, this is the date-time when the dwc:Event was recorded. Not suitable for a time in a geological context.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/eventTime
fields.title: Event Time
fields.description: The time or interval during which a dwc:Event occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/startDayOfYear
fields.title: Start Day Of Year
fields.description: The earliest integer day of the year on which the dwc:Event occurred (1 for January 1, 365 for December 31, except in a leap year, in which case it is 366).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/endDayOfYear
fields.title: End Day Of Year
fields.description: The latest integer day of the year on which the dwc:Event occurred (1 for January 1, 365 for December 31, except in a leap year, in which case it is 366).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/year
fields.title: Year
fields.description: The four-digit year in which the dwc:Event occurred, according to the Common Era Calendar.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/month
fields.title: Month
fields.description: The integer month in which the dwc:Event occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/day
fields.title: Day
fields.description: The integer day of the month on which the dwc:Event occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimEventDate
fields.title: Verbatim EventDate
fields.description: The verbatim original representation of the date and time information for a dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/habitat
fields.title: Habitat
fields.description: A category or description of the habitat in which the dwc:Event occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/samplingProtocol
fields.title: Sampling Protocol
fields.description: The names of, references to, or descriptions of the methods or protocols used during a dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/sampleSizeValue
fields.title: Sample Size Value
fields.description: A numeric value for a measurement of the size (time duration, length, area, or volume) of a sample in a sampling dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/sampleSizeUnit
fields.title: Sample Size Unit
fields.description: The unit of measurement of the size (time duration, length, area, or volume) of a sample in a sampling dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/samplingEffort
fields.title: Sampling Effort
fields.description: The amount of effort expended during a dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/fieldNotes
fields.title: Field Notes
fields.description: One of a) an indicator of the existence of, b) a reference to (publication, URI), or c) the text of notes taken in the field about the dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/eventRemarks
fields.title: Event Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locationID
fields.title: Location ID
fields.description: An identifier for the set of dcterms:Location information. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/higherGeographyID
fields.title: Higher Geography ID
fields.description: An identifier for the geographic region within which the dcterms:Location occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/higherGeography
fields.title: Higher Geography
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of geographic names less specific than the information captured in the dwc:locality term.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/continent
fields.title: Continent
fields.description: The name of the continent in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/waterBody
fields.title: Water Body
fields.description: The name of the water body in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/islandGroup
fields.title: Island Group
fields.description: The name of the island group in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/island
fields.title: Island
fields.description: The name of the island on or near which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/country
fields.title: Country
fields.description: The name of the country or major administrative unit in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/countryCode
fields.title: Country Code
fields.description: The standard code for the country in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/stateProvince
fields.title: First Order Division
fields.description: The name of the next smaller administrative region than country (state, province, canton, department, region, etc.) in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/county
fields.title: Second Order Division
fields.description: The full, unabbreviated name of the next smaller administrative region than stateProvince (county, shire, department, etc.) in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/municipality
fields.title: Third Order Division
fields.description: The full, unabbreviated name of the next smaller administrative region than county (city, municipality, etc.) in which the dcterms:Location occurs. Do not use this term for a nearby named place that does not contain the actual dcterms:Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locality
fields.title: Locality
fields.description: The specific description of the place.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLocality
fields.title: Verbatim Locality
fields.description: The original textual description of the place.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/minimumElevationInMeters
fields.title: Minimum Elevation In Meters
fields.description: The lower limit of the range of elevation (altitude, usually above sea level), in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/maximumElevationInMeters
fields.title: Maximum Elevation In Meters
fields.description: The upper limit of the range of elevation (altitude, usually above sea level), in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimElevation
fields.title: Verbatim Elevation
fields.description: The original description of the elevation (altitude, usually above sea level) of the Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verticalDatum
fields.title: Vertical Datum
fields.description: The vertical datum used as the reference upon which the values in the elevation terms are based.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/minimumDepthInMeters
fields.title: Minimum Depth In Meters
fields.description: The lesser depth of a range of depth below the local surface, in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/maximumDepthInMeters
fields.title: Maximum Depth In Meters
fields.description: The greater depth of a range of depth below the local surface, in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimDepth
fields.title: Verbatim Depth
fields.description: The original description of the depth below the local surface.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/minimumDistanceAboveSurfaceInMeters
fields.title: Minimum Distance Above Surface In Meters
fields.description: The lesser distance in a range of distance from a reference surface in the vertical direction, in meters. Use positive values for locations above the surface, negative values for locations below. If depth measures are given, the reference surface is the location given by the depth, otherwise the reference surface is the location given by the elevation.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/maximumDistanceAboveSurfaceInMeters
fields.title: Maximum Distance Above Surface In Meters
fields.description: The greater distance in a range of distance from a reference surface in the vertical direction, in meters. Use positive values for locations above the surface, negative values for locations below. If depth measures are given, the reference surface is the location given by the depth, otherwise the reference surface is the location given by the elevation.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locationAccordingTo
fields.title: Location According To
fields.description: Information about the source of this dcterms:Location information. Could be a publication (gazetteer), institution, or team of individuals.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locationRemarks
fields.title: Location Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the dcterms:Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/decimalLatitude
fields.title: Decimal Latitude
fields.description: The geographic latitude (in decimal degrees, using the spatial reference system given in dwc:geodeticDatum) of the geographic center of a dcterms:Location. Positive values are north of the Equator, negative values are south of it. Legal values lie between -90 and 90, inclusive.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/decimalLongitude
fields.title: Decimal Longitude
fields.description: The geographic longitude (in decimal degrees, using the spatial reference system given in dwc:geodeticDatum) of the geographic center of a dcterms:Location. Positive values are east of the Greenwich Meridian, negative values are west of it. Legal values lie between -180 and 180, inclusive.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/geodeticDatum
fields.title: Geodetic Datum
fields.description: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which the geographic coordinates given in dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude are based.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/coordinateUncertaintyInMeters
fields.title: Coordinate Uncertainty In Meters
fields.description: The horizontal distance (in meters) from the given dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude describing the smallest circle containing the whole of the dcterms:Location. Leave the value empty if the uncertainty is unknown, cannot be estimated, or is not applicable (because there are no coordinates). Zero is not a valid value for this term.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/coordinatePrecision
fields.title: Coordinate Precision
fields.description: A decimal representation of the precision of the coordinates given in the dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/pointRadiusSpatialFit
fields.title: Point Radius Spatial Fit
fields.description: The ratio of the area of the point-radius (dwc:decimalLatitude, dwc:decimalLongitude, dwc:coordinateUncertaintyInMeters) to the area of the true (original, or most specific) spatial representation of the dcterms:Location. Legal values are 0, greater than or equal to 1, or undefined. A value of 1 is an exact match or 100% overlap. A value of 0 should be used if the given point-radius does not completely contain the original representation. The dwc:pointRadiusSpatialFit is undefined (and should be left empty) if the original representation is any geometry without area (e.g., a point or polyline) and without uncertainty and the given georeference is not that same geometry (without uncertainty). If both the original and the given georeference are the same point, the dwc:pointRadiusSpatialFit is 1.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimCoordinates
fields.title: Verbatim Coordinates
fields.description: The verbatim original spatial coordinates of the dcterms:Location. The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in dwc:verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in dwc:verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLatitude
fields.title: Verbatim Latitude
fields.description: The verbatim original latitude of the dcterms:Location. The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in dwc:verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in dwc:verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLongitude
fields.title: Verbatim Longitude
fields.description: The verbatim original longitude of the dcterms:Location. The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in dwc:verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in dwc:verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimCoordinateSystem
fields.title: Verbatim Coordinate System
fields.description: The coordinate format for the dwc:verbatimLatitude and dwc:verbatimLongitude or the dwc:verbatimCoordinates of the dcterms:Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimSRS
fields.title: Verbatim SRS
fields.description: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which coordinates given in dwc:verbatimLatitude and dwc:verbatimLongitude, or dwc:verbatimCoordinates are based.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/footprintWKT
fields.title: Footprint WKT
fields.description: A Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the shape (footprint, geometry) that defines the dcterms:Location. A dcterms:Location may have both a point-radius representation (see dwc:decimalLatitude) and a footprint representation, and they may differ from each other.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/footprintSRS
fields.title: Footprint SRS
fields.description: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which the geometry given in dwc:footprintWKT is based.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/footprintSpatialFit
fields.title: Footprint Spatial Fit
fields.description: The ratio of the area of the dwc:footprintWKT to the area of the true (original, or most specific) spatial representation of the dcterms:Location. Legal values are 0, greater than or equal to 1, or undefined. A value of 1 is an exact match or 100% overlap. A value of 0 should be used if the given dwc:footprintWKT does not completely contain the original representation. The dwc:footprintSpatialFit is undefined (and should be left empty) if the original representation is any geometry without area (e.g., a point or polyline) and without uncertainty and the given georeference is not that same geometry (without uncertainty). If both the original and the given georeference are the same point, the dwc:footprintSpatialFit is 1.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferencedBy
fields.title: Georeferenced By
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of people, groups, or organizations who determined the georeference (spatial representation) for the dcterms:Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferencedDate
fields.title: Georeferenced Date
fields.description: The date on which the dcterms:Location was georeferenced.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceProtocol
fields.title: Georeference Protocol
fields.description: A description or reference to the methods used to determine the spatial footprint, coordinates, and uncertainties.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceSources
fields.title: Georeference Sources
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of maps, gazetteers, or other resources used to georeference the dcterms:Location, described specifically enough to allow anyone in the future to use the same resources.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceRemarks
fields.title: Georeference Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the spatial description determination, explaining assumptions made in addition or opposition to the those formalized in the method referred to in dwc:georeferenceProtocol.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/geologicalContextID
fields.title: Geological Context ID
fields.description: An identifier for the set of information associated with a dwc:GeologicalContext (the location within a geological context, such as stratigraphy). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/earliestEonOrLowestEonothem
fields.title: Earliest Eon Or Lowest Eonothem
fields.description: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic eon or lowest chrono-stratigraphic eonothem or the informal name ("Precambrian") attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/latestEonOrHighestEonothem
fields.title: Latest Eon Or Highest Eonothem
fields.description: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic eon or highest chrono-stratigraphic eonothem or the informal name ("Precambrian") attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/earliestEraOrLowestErathem
fields.title: Earliest Era Or Lowest Erathem
fields.description: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic era or lowest chronostratigraphic erathem attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/latestEraOrHighestErathem
fields.title: Latest Era Or Highest Erathem
fields.description: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic era or highest chronostratigraphic erathem attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/earliestPeriodOrLowestSystem
fields.title: Earliest Period Or Lowest System
fields.description: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic period or lowest chronostratigraphic system attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/latestPeriodOrHighestSystem
fields.title: Latest Period Or Highest System
fields.description: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic period or highest chronostratigraphic system attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/earliestEpochOrLowestSeries
fields.title: Earliest Epoch Or Lowest Series
fields.description: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic epoch or lowest chronostratigraphic series attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/latestEpochOrHighestSeries
fields.title: Latest Epoch Or Highest Series
fields.description: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic epoch or highest chronostratigraphic series attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/earliestAgeOrLowestStage
fields.title: Earliest Age Or Lowest Stage
fields.description: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic age or lowest chronostratigraphic stage attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/latestAgeOrHighestStage
fields.title: Latest Age Or Highest Stage
fields.description: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic age or highest chronostratigraphic stage attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/lowestBiostratigraphicZone
fields.title: Lowest Biostratigraphic Zone
fields.description: The full name of the lowest possible geological biostratigraphic zone of the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/highestBiostratigraphicZone
fields.title: Highest Biostratigraphic Zone
fields.description: The full name of the highest possible geological biostratigraphic zone of the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/lithostratigraphicTerms
fields.title: Lithostratigraphic Terms
fields.description: The combination of all lithostratigraphic names for the rock from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/group
fields.title: Group
fields.description: The full name of the lithostratigraphic group from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/formation
fields.title: Formation
fields.description: The full name of the lithostratigraphic formation from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/member
fields.title: Member
fields.description: The full name of the lithostratigraphic member from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/bed
fields.title: Bed
fields.description: The full name of the lithostratigraphic bed from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.title: Dynamic Properties
fields.description: A list of additional measurements, facts, characteristics, or assertions about the record. Meant to provide a mechanism for structured content.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/occurrenceID
fields.title: Occurrence ID
fields.description: An identifier for the dwc:Occurrence (as opposed to a particular digital record of the dwc:Occurrence). In the absence of a persistent global unique identifier, construct one from a combination of identifiers in the record that will most closely make the dwc:occurrenceID globally unique.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/catalogNumber
fields.title: Catalog Number
fields.description: An identifier (preferably unique) for the record within the data set or collection.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/recordNumber
fields.title: Record Number
fields.description: An identifier given to the dwc:Occurrence at the time it was recorded. Often serves as a link between field notes and a dwc:Occurrence record, such as a specimen collector's number.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/recordedBy
fields.title: Recorded By
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of people, groups, or organizations responsible for recording the original dwc:Occurrence. The primary collector or observer, especially one who applies a personal identifier (dwc:recordNumber), should be listed first.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/recordedByID
fields.title: Recorded By ID
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of the globally unique identifier for the person, people, groups, or organizations responsible for recording the original dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/individualCount
fields.title: Individual Count
fields.description: The number of individuals present at the time of the dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/organismQuantity
fields.title: Organism Quantity
fields.description: A number or enumeration value for the quantity of dwc:Organisms.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/organismQuantityType
fields.title: Organism Quantity Type
fields.description: The type of quantification system used for the quantity of dwc:Organisms.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/sex
fields.title: Sex
fields.description: The sex of the biological individual(s) represented in the dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/lifeStage
fields.title: Life Stage
fields.description: The age class or life stage of the dwc:Organism(s) at the time the dwc:Occurrence was recorded.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/reproductiveCondition
fields.title: Reproductive Condition
fields.description: The reproductive condition of the biological individual(s) represented in the dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/caste
fields.title: Caste
fields.description: Categorisation of individuals for eusocial species (including some mammals and arthropods).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/behavior
fields.title: Behavior
fields.description: The behavior shown by the subject at the time the dwc:Occurrence was recorded.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/vitality
fields.title: Vitality
fields.description: An indication of whether a dwc:Organism was alive or dead at the time of collection or observation.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/establishmentMeans
fields.title: Establishment Means
fields.description: Statement about whether a dwc:Organism has been introduced to a given place and time through the direct or indirect activity of modern humans.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/degreeOfEstablishment
fields.title: Degree of Establishment
fields.description: The degree to which a dwc:Organism survives, reproduces, and expands its range at the given place and time.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/pathway
fields.title: Pathway
fields.description: The process by which a dwc:Organism came to be in a given place at a given time.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceVerificationStatus
fields.title: Georeference Verification Status
fields.description: A categorical description of the extent to which the georeference has been verified to represent the best possible spatial description for the dcterms:Location of the dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/occurrenceStatus
fields.title: Occurrence Status
fields.description: A statement about the presence or absence of a dwc:Taxon at a dcterms:Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/associatedMedia
fields.title: Associated Media
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers (publication, global unique identifier, URI) of media associated with the dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/associatedOccurrences
fields.title: Associated Occurrences
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers of other dwc:Occurrence records and their associations to this dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/associatedReferences
fields.title: Associated References
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers (publication, bibliographic reference, global unique identifier, URI) of literature associated with the dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/associatedTaxa
fields.title: Associated Taxa
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers or names of dwc:Taxon records and the associations of this dwc:Occurrence to each of them.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/otherCatalogNumbers
fields.title: Other Catalog Numbers
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of previous or alternate fully qualified catalog numbers or other human-used identifiers for the same dwc:Occurrence, whether in the current or any other data set or collection.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/occurrenceRemarks
fields.title: Occurrence Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the dwc:Occurrence.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/organismID
fields.title: Organism ID
fields.description: An identifier for the dwc:Organism instance (as opposed to a particular digital record of the dwc:Organism). May be a globally unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/organismName
fields.title: Organism Name
fields.description: A textual name or label assigned to a dwc:Organism instance.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/organismScope
fields.title: Organism Scope
fields.description: A description of the kind of dwc:Organism instance. Can be used to indicate whether the dwc:Organism instance represents a discrete organism or if it represents a particular type of aggregation.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/associatedOrganisms
fields.title: Associated Organisms
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers of other dwc:Organisms and the associations of this dwc:Organism to each of them.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/previousIdentifications
fields.title: Previous Identifications
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of previous assignments of names to the dwc:Organism.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/organismRemarks
fields.title: Organism Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the dwc:Organism instance.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/causeOfDeath
fields.title: Cause Of Death
fields.description: An indication of the known or suspected cause of death of a dwc:Organism.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/materialEntityID
fields.title: Material Entity ID
fields.description: An identifier for a particular instance of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/digitalSpecimenID
fields.title: Digital Specimen Identifier
fields.description: An identifier for a particular instance of a Digital Specimen.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/materialEntityType
fields.title: Material Entity Type
fields.description: A category that best matches the nature of a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/discipline
fields.title: Discipline
fields.description: The primary branch or branches of knowledge represented by the record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/preparations
fields.title: Preparations
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of preparations and preservation methods for a dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/disposition
fields.title: Disposition
fields.description: The current state of a dwc:MaterialEntity with respect to a collection.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLabel
fields.title: Verbatim Label
fields.description: The content of this term should include no embellishments, prefixes, headers or other additions made to the text. Abbreviations must not be expanded and supposed misspellings must not be corrected. Lines or breakpoints between blocks of text that could be verified by seeing the original labels or images of them may be used. Examples of material entities include preserved specimens, fossil specimens, and material samples. Best practice is to use UTF-8 for all characters. Best practice is to add comment “verbatimLabel derived from human transcription” in dwc:occurrenceRemarks.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/associatedSequences
fields.title: Associated Sequences
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers (publication, global unique identifier, URI) of genetic sequence information associated with the dwc:MaterialEntity.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/materialEntityRemarks
fields.title: Material Entity Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the dwc:MaterialEntity instance.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/materialSampleID
fields.title: Material Sample ID
fields.description: An identifier for the dwc:MaterialSample (as opposed to a particular digital record of the dwc:MaterialSample). In the absence of a persistent global unique identifier, construct one from a combination of identifiers in the record that will most closely make the dwc:materialSampleID globally unique.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/eventID
fields.title: Event ID
fields.description: An identifier for the set of information associated with a dwc:Event (something that occurs at a place and time). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/parentEventID
fields.title: Parent Event ID
fields.description: An identifier for the broader dwc:Event that groups this and potentially other dwc:Events.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/eventType
fields.title: Event Type
fields.description: The nature of the dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/projectTitle
fields.title: Project Title
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of titles or names for projects that contributed to a dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/projectID
fields.title: Project ID
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers for projects that contributed to a dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/fundingAttribution
fields.title: Funding Attribution
fields.description: Text description of organizations or individuals who funded the creation of the resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/fundingAttributionID
fields.title: Funding Attribution ID
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of the globally unique identifiers for the funding organizations or agencies that supported the project.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/fieldNumber
fields.title: Field Number
fields.description: An identifier given to the dwc:Event in the field. Often serves as a link between field notes and the dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/eventDate
fields.title: Event Date
fields.description: The date-time or interval during which a dwc:Event occurred. For occurrences, this is the date-time when the dwc:Event was recorded. Not suitable for a time in a geological context.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/eventTime
fields.title: Event Time
fields.description: The time or interval during which a dwc:Event occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/startDayOfYear
fields.title: Start Day Of Year
fields.description: The earliest integer day of the year on which the dwc:Event occurred (1 for January 1, 365 for December 31, except in a leap year, in which case it is 366).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/endDayOfYear
fields.title: End Day Of Year
fields.description: The latest integer day of the year on which the dwc:Event occurred (1 for January 1, 365 for December 31, except in a leap year, in which case it is 366).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/year
fields.title: Year
fields.description: The four-digit year in which the dwc:Event occurred, according to the Common Era Calendar.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/month
fields.title: Month
fields.description: The integer month in which the dwc:Event occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/day
fields.title: Day
fields.description: The integer day of the month on which the dwc:Event occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimEventDate
fields.title: Verbatim EventDate
fields.description: The verbatim original representation of the date and time information for a dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/habitat
fields.title: Habitat
fields.description: A category or description of the habitat in which the dwc:Event occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/samplingProtocol
fields.title: Sampling Protocol
fields.description: The names of, references to, or descriptions of the methods or protocols used during a dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/sampleSizeValue
fields.title: Sample Size Value
fields.description: A numeric value for a measurement of the size (time duration, length, area, or volume) of a sample in a sampling dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/sampleSizeUnit
fields.title: Sample Size Unit
fields.description: The unit of measurement of the size (time duration, length, area, or volume) of a sample in a sampling dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/samplingEffort
fields.title: Sampling Effort
fields.description: The amount of effort expended during a dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/fieldNotes
fields.title: Field Notes
fields.description: One of a) an indicator of the existence of, b) a reference to (publication, URI), or c) the text of notes taken in the field about the dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/eventRemarks
fields.title: Event Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locationID
fields.title: Location ID
fields.description: An identifier for the set of dcterms:Location information. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/higherGeographyID
fields.title: Higher Geography ID
fields.description: An identifier for the geographic region within which the dcterms:Location occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/higherGeography
fields.title: Higher Geography
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of geographic names less specific than the information captured in the dwc:locality term.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/continent
fields.title: Continent
fields.description: The name of the continent in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/waterBody
fields.title: Water Body
fields.description: The name of the water body in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/islandGroup
fields.title: Island Group
fields.description: The name of the island group in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/island
fields.title: Island
fields.description: The name of the island on or near which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/country
fields.title: Country
fields.description: The name of the country or major administrative unit in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/countryCode
fields.title: Country Code
fields.description: The standard code for the country in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/stateProvince
fields.title: First Order Division
fields.description: The name of the next smaller administrative region than country (state, province, canton, department, region, etc.) in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/county
fields.title: Second Order Division
fields.description: The full, unabbreviated name of the next smaller administrative region than stateProvince (county, shire, department, etc.) in which the dcterms:Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/municipality
fields.title: Third Order Division
fields.description: The full, unabbreviated name of the next smaller administrative region than county (city, municipality, etc.) in which the dcterms:Location occurs. Do not use this term for a nearby named place that does not contain the actual dcterms:Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locality
fields.title: Locality
fields.description: The specific description of the place.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLocality
fields.title: Verbatim Locality
fields.description: The original textual description of the place.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/minimumElevationInMeters
fields.title: Minimum Elevation In Meters
fields.description: The lower limit of the range of elevation (altitude, usually above sea level), in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/maximumElevationInMeters
fields.title: Maximum Elevation In Meters
fields.description: The upper limit of the range of elevation (altitude, usually above sea level), in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimElevation
fields.title: Verbatim Elevation
fields.description: The original description of the elevation (altitude, usually above sea level) of the Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verticalDatum
fields.title: Vertical Datum
fields.description: The vertical datum used as the reference upon which the values in the elevation terms are based.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/minimumDepthInMeters
fields.title: Minimum Depth In Meters
fields.description: The lesser depth of a range of depth below the local surface, in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/maximumDepthInMeters
fields.title: Maximum Depth In Meters
fields.description: The greater depth of a range of depth below the local surface, in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimDepth
fields.title: Verbatim Depth
fields.description: The original description of the depth below the local surface.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/minimumDistanceAboveSurfaceInMeters
fields.title: Minimum Distance Above Surface In Meters
fields.description: The lesser distance in a range of distance from a reference surface in the vertical direction, in meters. Use positive values for locations above the surface, negative values for locations below. If depth measures are given, the reference surface is the location given by the depth, otherwise the reference surface is the location given by the elevation.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/maximumDistanceAboveSurfaceInMeters
fields.title: Maximum Distance Above Surface In Meters
fields.description: The greater distance in a range of distance from a reference surface in the vertical direction, in meters. Use positive values for locations above the surface, negative values for locations below. If depth measures are given, the reference surface is the location given by the depth, otherwise the reference surface is the location given by the elevation.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locationAccordingTo
fields.title: Location According To
fields.description: Information about the source of this dcterms:Location information. Could be a publication (gazetteer), institution, or team of individuals.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locationRemarks
fields.title: Location Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the dcterms:Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/decimalLatitude
fields.title: Decimal Latitude
fields.description: The geographic latitude (in decimal degrees, using the spatial reference system given in dwc:geodeticDatum) of the geographic center of a dcterms:Location. Positive values are north of the Equator, negative values are south of it. Legal values lie between -90 and 90, inclusive.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/decimalLongitude
fields.title: Decimal Longitude
fields.description: The geographic longitude (in decimal degrees, using the spatial reference system given in dwc:geodeticDatum) of the geographic center of a dcterms:Location. Positive values are east of the Greenwich Meridian, negative values are west of it. Legal values lie between -180 and 180, inclusive.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/geodeticDatum
fields.title: Geodetic Datum
fields.description: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which the geographic coordinates given in dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude are based.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/coordinateUncertaintyInMeters
fields.title: Coordinate Uncertainty In Meters
fields.description: The horizontal distance (in meters) from the given dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude describing the smallest circle containing the whole of the dcterms:Location. Leave the value empty if the uncertainty is unknown, cannot be estimated, or is not applicable (because there are no coordinates). Zero is not a valid value for this term.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/coordinatePrecision
fields.title: Coordinate Precision
fields.description: A decimal representation of the precision of the coordinates given in the dwc:decimalLatitude and dwc:decimalLongitude.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/pointRadiusSpatialFit
fields.title: Point Radius Spatial Fit
fields.description: The ratio of the area of the point-radius (dwc:decimalLatitude, dwc:decimalLongitude, dwc:coordinateUncertaintyInMeters) to the area of the true (original, or most specific) spatial representation of the dcterms:Location. Legal values are 0, greater than or equal to 1, or undefined. A value of 1 is an exact match or 100% overlap. A value of 0 should be used if the given point-radius does not completely contain the original representation. The dwc:pointRadiusSpatialFit is undefined (and should be left empty) if the original representation is any geometry without area (e.g., a point or polyline) and without uncertainty and the given georeference is not that same geometry (without uncertainty). If both the original and the given georeference are the same point, the dwc:pointRadiusSpatialFit is 1.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimCoordinates
fields.title: Verbatim Coordinates
fields.description: The verbatim original spatial coordinates of the dcterms:Location. The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in dwc:verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in dwc:verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLatitude
fields.title: Verbatim Latitude
fields.description: The verbatim original latitude of the dcterms:Location. The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in dwc:verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in dwc:verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLongitude
fields.title: Verbatim Longitude
fields.description: The verbatim original longitude of the dcterms:Location. The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in dwc:verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in dwc:verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimCoordinateSystem
fields.title: Verbatim Coordinate System
fields.description: The coordinate format for the dwc:verbatimLatitude and dwc:verbatimLongitude or the dwc:verbatimCoordinates of the dcterms:Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimSRS
fields.title: Verbatim SRS
fields.description: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which coordinates given in dwc:verbatimLatitude and dwc:verbatimLongitude, or dwc:verbatimCoordinates are based.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/footprintWKT
fields.title: Footprint WKT
fields.description: A Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the shape (footprint, geometry) that defines the dcterms:Location. A dcterms:Location may have both a point-radius representation (see dwc:decimalLatitude) and a footprint representation, and they may differ from each other.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/footprintSRS
fields.title: Footprint SRS
fields.description: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which the geometry given in dwc:footprintWKT is based.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/footprintSpatialFit
fields.title: Footprint Spatial Fit
fields.description: The ratio of the area of the dwc:footprintWKT to the area of the true (original, or most specific) spatial representation of the dcterms:Location. Legal values are 0, greater than or equal to 1, or undefined. A value of 1 is an exact match or 100% overlap. A value of 0 should be used if the given dwc:footprintWKT does not completely contain the original representation. The dwc:footprintSpatialFit is undefined (and should be left empty) if the original representation is any geometry without area (e.g., a point or polyline) and without uncertainty and the given georeference is not that same geometry (without uncertainty). If both the original and the given georeference are the same point, the dwc:footprintSpatialFit is 1.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferencedBy
fields.title: Georeferenced By
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of people, groups, or organizations who determined the georeference (spatial representation) for the dcterms:Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferencedDate
fields.title: Georeferenced Date
fields.description: The date on which the dcterms:Location was georeferenced.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceProtocol
fields.title: Georeference Protocol
fields.description: A description or reference to the methods used to determine the spatial footprint, coordinates, and uncertainties.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceSources
fields.title: Georeference Sources
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of maps, gazetteers, or other resources used to georeference the dcterms:Location, described specifically enough to allow anyone in the future to use the same resources.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceRemarks
fields.title: Georeference Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the spatial description determination, explaining assumptions made in addition or opposition to the those formalized in the method referred to in dwc:georeferenceProtocol.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/geologicalContextID
fields.title: Geological Context ID
fields.description: An identifier for the set of information associated with a dwc:GeologicalContext (the location within a geological context, such as stratigraphy). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/earliestEonOrLowestEonothem
fields.title: Earliest Eon Or Lowest Eonothem
fields.description: The full name of the earliest possible geochronologic eon or lowest chrono-stratigraphic eonothem or the informal name ("Precambrian") attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/latestEonOrHighestEonothem
fields.title: Latest Eon Or Highest Eonothem
fields.description: The full name of the latest possible geochronologic eon or highest chrono-stratigraphic eonothem or the informal name ("Precambrian") attributable to the stratigraphic horizon from which the dwc:MaterialEntity was collected.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/earliestEraOrLowestErathem
